profile.Name: General Hat-12
profile.Job: Former chief of police of the Second Empire
profile.Personality: A Skeleton who once ran the Second Empire's police; nothing of his temperament is recorded.
profile.Backstory: He once led the police of the Second Empire. He is found in Ashland Dome IV, armed with a superb heavy jitte, and carries his own unique CPU.
profile.SpeechQuirks: No speech of his is recorded.
